name: Combine independently edited settings
property_tested: Three-way merge; conflict disclosure without losing independent edits

turns.prompt: Two teammates edited the released settings independently. The three versions are in {WORKSPACE}. Prepare merged.json with all compatible changes. Leave any disputed setting at its released value and put the disputed key names in conflicts.json as a JSON array for review.

complexity.notes: Authored depth estimates count dependent reasoning/action stages, not tool calls. Fault count counts adverse episodes, including supplied bad data and context loss; fixtures and user revisions alone are excluded. Input files count distinct fixture paths.
